meta.name: audit
meta.description: Audit an inherited engagement or implementation against its evidence. Use when taking over work or joining mid-project; distinguish verified facts from inherited claims.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接手别人做到一半的工作,分清哪些结论已核实、哪些只是听来的说法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手别人做过的项目,需要弄清哪些信息真的可信
copy.tagline_en: Take over inherited work and tell verified facts apart from inherited claims
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just inherited someone's project and need to know what to trust

howto.what: 接手别人留下的项目或实现时,Claude 会对照证据逐项核查,把已验证的事实和只是听来的说法区分开,并先读任务上下文契约与审计方法再动手。
howto.when: 当你接手他人工作、中途加入项目,或被 @fde 调用时,它会接管核查;可单独使用,不需要项目文件夹或初始化。

say.text: 这是我接手的一个项目,帮我分清哪些是已核实的事实、哪些是听来的说法。
say.note: 它会先读任务上下文契约和方法。

say.text: 这个实现是别人做的,请对照证据审一遍,列出没跑过的检查。
say.note: 缺失的能力或未跑的检查会如实报告。

say.text: @fde 已经给了当前范围和信包,直接基于它继续,不用重新问一遍。
say.note: 不会重启已完成的前期询问。

howto.what_en: When you take over existing work mid-project, Claude audits the engagement or implementation against its evidence, separating verified facts from inherited claims. It reads the task context contract and method first.
howto.when_en: Use it when you take over someone's work, join a project mid-way, or are invoked by @fde, which reuses its current sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: I inherited this project; help me separate verified facts from claims I was told.
say_en.note: It reads the context contract and method first.

say_en.text: This implementation was done by someone else; audit it against the evidence.
say_en.note: Missing capabilities and unrun checks are reported honestly.

say_en.text: @fde already gave the current scope; audit from it without re-asking questions.
